title: Start fresh, don't drag old branches
reason: Long-lived session transcript; old branches make the next session heavier than the prompt looks.
action:
When the task changes meaningfully, start a clean session instead of resuming. Use /compact only with explicit preservation, e.g.:
  /compact
  Preserve: objective, files changed, tests run, unresolved blockers, next exact command.
  Discard: raw logs, repeated failed attempts, obsolete exploration.

title: Prune hidden ~/.claude/projects memory
reason: Hidden per-project Claude memory store; biggest invisible cost on most machines.
action: Archive or delete project memory directories you no longer resume; prune the oldest .jsonl files first. Externalize durable state into NEXUS.md, decision records, handoff notes, and commits so new sessions recover from artifacts instead of raw transcript history.

title: Shrink always-loaded instructions
reason: Project instruction surface; loaded as standing context every session.
action: Long instructions are useful until they become tax. Keep always-loaded files focused on identity, safety, and essential operating rules. Move details into task-specific skill files, referenced docs, templates, checklists, or short command wrappers.

title: Scope global rules to truly cross-project
reason: Global rules surface; affects every session even when the current project looks small.
action: Keep only cross-project rules globally; move project-specific rules into the project's own instructions or skills. Globals load on every session regardless of task, so each line there is a per-prompt tax.

title: Audit hooks and MCP defaults
reason: Tool, MCP, and hook configuration; may activate extra context or model-visible hook output.
action: Hook output on UserPromptSubmit, SessionStart, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, and Stop can become model-visible context every turn. Real cost is hook_output_size x turns x relevance. Disable hooks unrelated to the task; move long memory/context recalls behind explicit commands; never let failed auth loops keep injecting repeated context.

title: Keep skills callable, not standing prose
reason: Skill/procedure surface; oversized procedures become invisible context tax.
action: Treat tools as a budget. Before an expensive session ask which tools the task actually needs, then disable or avoid unrelated tool contexts. Keep skills focused and callable; avoid loading long procedures as standing prose.

title: Cap MCP servers, skills, and agents per session
reason: High MCP server / skill / agent count inflates standing tool context every session, regardless of task.
action:
Treat tools as a budget. Before an expensive session, list which MCP servers, skills, and agents the task actually needs and disable the rest:
  - Edit ~/.claude/claude.json or settings.json to remove unused mcpServers entries.
  - Move rarely-used skills out of ~/.claude/skills (or scope them to specific projects).
  - Archive agents in ~/.claude/agents that are not relevant to the current task.
Re-enable surgically when a task actually needs them.

title: Inspect this surface
reason: Visible local surface worth inspecting before the next expensive session.
action: Inspect this surface and pick one safe cleanup or isolation rule before the next expensive session.
